{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] '''''Firestorm''''' failed to destroy the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Stimsenj'kat]]'' which was having cargo transferred from Transport Group [[Renhoek (transports)|''Renhoek'']], which was made up of at least six [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]]. The ''Firestorm'' was destroyed by the ''Stimsenj'kat'', along with [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and a few other [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]].
